summary:
PROPOSED, not yet accepted (FS.GG.Game#789, Outcome .github#5218). The ADR docs/roadmaps/game-render-02-glyphs.md (PR #794) is canonical, and this record indexes it.

**Observed (2026-11-01):**
- Five games build their own symbology from opaque Rectangle, Circle and FilledEllipse nodes, the canvas ceiling (SceneShapes.fs skips the rest). They fake strokes by layering and duplicate helpers and palettes.
- The Fable view of FS.GG.UI.Scene (Rendering 2d35dc9b) lacks the Colors, Paint, Path and Scene constructors. The intake is Rendering#1504, scoped to the portable subset.
- ScenePixels treats an unmodelled node (text, path, image) as Partial everywhere, so a pixel is decided only if a later opaque node wholly covers it. On the 391-pixel proof board, one text node drawn first leaves 391 decided, in the middle 234, and last 0.

**Decisions (proposed):**
- **Glyphs** are compositional (APP-6 / milsymbol slots: frame, fill with a lightness step, icon, size step, team mark, inner modifiers, amplifiers). All types are opaque with builders, so #795's Symbology<'Entity> targets them.
- **Hit bounds** (`GlyphDrawing.frame`) are the frame's drawn bounding box, independent of state; at a nominal 24, Enemy is 20x20 and Unknown 30x30.
- **Identity frames** are fixed by the library, never the theme, and built only from bars:
  - Own: the friend rectangle. Ally: the same with TRUE HOLES at the quarter points of the top and bottom edges, never at edge midpoints.
  - Neutral: a square. Enemy: a stepped diamond. Unknown: a stepped quatrefoil.
  - Frames always snap to whole units (centre Floor(v+0.5), size floored); the distinguishability matrix holds only then.
  - With D6's corner and quarter-edge samples, every pair differs by at least 4 both ways from 8 to 32 units, identically on SVG, Pixi and Babylon. With today's mid-edge samples, Own/Ally is 0 by design.
  - Every frame passes the box-edge check. The minimum identity size is 12 units; below it, colour plus the mirror label.
- **Team** is double-encoded:
  - A seven-segment index badge (3x5 whole-unit cells, unit at least 2, so at least 10 units tall) is mandatory whenever two or more of the game's teams share an allegiance. D6's samples separate all 36 digit pairs.
  - The badge is drawn INSIDE its frame, at the inner centre, in the body pass right after its frame, so neighbours never cover it. As a first-pass amplifier, the review found 0 of 6 interior badges intact.
  - The badge needs a frame of at least 22 units (measured: Neutral 12, Unknown 16, Own 18, Enemy 20, Ally 22). Below that it is omitted with a diagnostic, and team rests on the frame plus the label.
  - Badge ink is at least 3:1 on every fill. The identity matrix is unchanged with badges drawn (all 81 digit combinations). At 22-39 units the badge displaces the icon (Q15).
  - Above the hue capacity, team colour falls back to allegiance.
- **Passes:** amplifiers, then bodies (each frame followed by its own badge), then brackets, then cues, so no amplifier covers a frame or a badge. A dense-board kit case proves it.
- **Cue layer:** `Glyphs.cues : (unit -> Theme) -> CueContext -> SceneNode list`, as agreed in merged #793 (bfd1257d).
  - The focus ring sits against the frame, then the gap, then the brackets. Each band is at least 2 CSS px.
  - minCssPerUnit defaults to 1, and gap >= 1/minCssPerUnit. Hover is opt-in.
- **Tokens:** seed, map and alias, with composable algorithms. 3:1 contrast against real neighbours (7:1 provisional for high contrast), opaque only. DTCG 2025.10, with hex preferred; CSS and hex export. The theme is a runtime view input.
- **Colour:** OKLCH in F#, clamp then Floor(v+0.5), NOT Floor. Floor failed on 94.8% of 16.7M round trips, with 44.6% .NET-vs-Node differences; both are 0 with half-up. Contrast is validated on 8-bit values via a table, and hex is checked on Linux .NET, Windows .NET and Node.
- **Sprites:** a vector fallback for every frame; restricted images stay out of repositories; a three-role recolour template with binary transparency.
- **Licensing:** apca-w3 is never ported; Brogue, DCSS, Cogmind and Qud are ideas only.

**Proof** (experimental FS.GG.Game.Reference.Experimental.Glyphs): the browser smoke passes 511 checks on software and GPU. Per backend:
- all 403 decided board pixels;
- the identity strip (160) and 20 frame pairs;
- the badge strip (684) and 72 digit pairs;
- the dense board with inside badges (1203) and its bodies-first control;
- the 20 frame pairs again with badges.

**Lessons:**
- Colour quantisation after float maths: clamp, then Floor(v+0.5).
- Identity shapes must differ at sampled positions, so frames are built from bars and stay on whole units.

**Plan:** D6's corner and quarter-edge samples ship with the frames and badges (step 3); they wait on neither #786 nor #773.

**Not established:** acceptance, the implementation, consumer adoption, publication.
title: GAME-RENDER-02.4 shared glyph and symbology layer with theme tokens (proposed ADR and three-backend proof)
